# FUSE on DICES-990 against an LLM safety label (generated by scripts/run_dices990.py)

Reference label: `dices990_v4` (results/llm_labels). DICES-990 has no expert label, so every accuracy below is agreement with the LLM label, not with experts.

| FUSE (logistic) | 71.0 | 65.5 | 79.8 | 17.3 | -0.4 [-2.1, +1.4] |

| Oracle best verifier | 74.1 | 75.0 | 75.1 | 49.9 | +2.7 [-1.0, +6.5] |
